title: Decision
description: The policy engine's answer for one action. Mirrors shield-core::model::Decision. Precedence when combining decisions is deny > ask > allow.

rule_id.description: Id of the rule that produced this decision. Omitted for unmatched actions and for escalations by the risk scorer.

matched_rule_ids.description: All policy rules that matched, in policy order.

reason_user.description: One line for the human approving or reviewing the action.

reason_agent.description: Message returned to the agent, written so it re-plans instead of retrying.

risk_score.description: Layer 2 risk estimate. Scores at or above the policy ask_threshold escalate an allow to an ask; they never downgrade.
